sentences.text: The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-

The case of the prosecution is that the accused No.1 in order to pay his debt he joined with accused No.2 to 5 with C.C.No.19645/2016 common intention, the accused No.1 falsely informed the CW-1 that he is an agent of a prestigious gold company and he is supplying gold chains and he informed the CW-1 that he having a gold bars and he will give the gold bars for making gold chain.

On 12.04.2016 the accused No.1 gave a gold bar weighing 278 grams to the accused No.2 in Coimbatore, Tamilnadu for making 12 gold chains weighing about 238 grams on various designs from the CW-1 and told him to keep the remaining gold as an advance for the next business.
Thereafter, the accused No.1 ordered the CW-1 for making 10 kilo gold jewelers and he will give the gold bar to him.
Believing the words of the accused No.1 the CW-1 made various 160 gold chains weighing 2386 grams worth of Rs.70.41.663/-.

As per the information of the accused No.1 the CW-1 came to Bengaluru on 01.05.2016 with CW-2 at Koramangala Forum and also CW-1 took the CW-3 to the said place and the accused No.1 was sent the accused No.2 to the said address and informed the CW-1, 3 and 5 to come to the Building No.369, 3rd Floor, 1st A Cross, 7th Block, Koramangala and the accused No.2 collected the various 160 gold chains weighing 2386 grams worth of Rs.70.41.663/- from the CW-1 by C.C.No.19645/2016 pretended to be Sanjay and informed that he will coming purity check of the said gold chains and also given copper bars by wrapped in a paper by telling them to gold bars and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.

After completion of the investigation the PSI of Koramangala Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable under sections 406, 420 and 120(B) read with section 34 of IPC.
